description: Account OAuth client the app's functions use. The secret is only readable by this app's functions, never by its users. Configure it in the app (Overview or Permissions Test) or here.

accountUuid.description: UUID of the Dynatrace account this environment belongs to (Account Management > Identity & access management > OAuth clients shows it).

oauthClientId.description: OAuth client of the account (dt0s02.…) with account-idm-read, iam:bindings:read, iam:policies:read and iam:boundaries:read.

permissionsTestForAllUsers.displayName: Overview and Permissions Test for every app user
permissionsTestForAllUsers.description: Off: only users who can change this app's settings can see the Overview and run the Permissions Test (they read the account's groups, members, policies and boundaries).
